author: NASASpaceflight
description:
Launch Window: April 20th from 2:57AM to 3:12AM EDT (06:57-07:12 UTC)
Current T0: April 20th at 2:57AM EDT (06:57 UTC)

Mission: Falcon 9 launch of the GPS-III SV10 Hedy Lamarr satellite for the US Space Force
Launch location: Space Launch Complex 40 (SLC-40), Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Earth.
Target orbit: Medium Earth Orbit (MEO)
Booster: B1095-7; 36d 18h 19min 50s turnaround
Booster history: SL 12-15, SL 10-56, SL 10-52, SL 6-86, SL 6-101, SL 10-48.
Satellites launched: 166, will be 167 after this mission.
Booster recovery: Just Read The Instructions (JRTI)
Fairing recovery: Bob
Rocket trajectory: Straight east
Payload mass: Approximately 4 metric tons.
Stats:
  - SpaceX's 657th launch overall.
  - SpaceX's 48th launch of the year.
  - SpaceX's 8th launch of the month.
  - Earth's 91st orbital launch of the year.
  - Falcon's 277th launch since the last failure.
  - Falcon 9's 629th orbital flight.
  - SpaceX's 323rd launch from SLC-40.
  - 155th landing on JRTI out of 156
title: SpaceX Falcon 9 launches GPS-III SV10 (GPS III-8)
